lines.text: Many learners say: Please enter to the room.

native.tip: Kita bilang “masuk ke ruangan”, tapi enter tidak butuh to: enter the room.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Please enter to the room.” 😅 Setelah enter, tidak perlu to: “Please enter the room.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “enter”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Please enter the room.” Lalu ganti room dengan house. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “masuk ke ruangan”, but enter does not need to: enter the room.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Please enter to the room.” 😅 After enter, you do not need to: “Please enter the room.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
